keskihinta_aritm: Prices per square metre are weighted arithmetic averages of square metre prices (EUR/m²). Prices per square metre describe regional differences in price levels and they should not be used to calculate price change.
lkm_julk19: The data on numbers describe asset transfer tax statements received from the Tax Administration by the time of release in the area. The data on numbers of old dwellings in housing companies will become revised in the following releases. Final data for the year are published when all the transfer tax statements  are received from the Tax Administration, normally in May. The latest months number of transactions should not be used when describing the activeness of trading. Instead the number of transactions describe the quality of published price data.

The number of transactions include transactions of price controlled HITAS dwellings and Housing Finance and Development Centre ARA dwellings in the area that not included in the price indices and prices per square metre.
Due to changes in the data, the numbers of sales are not strictly comparable starting from the last quarter of 2019.
The number of dwelling transactions includes price controlled HITAS and government-subsidised dwellings, as well as observations that are removed due to an area or price deviation from the calculation of the price per square metre or index. HITAS and government-subsidised dwellings and the above-mentioned outlier observations are excluded from the calculation of prices per square metre and indices.
